Pick the tool by the next action

For a mixed stack that needs a repeatable review step before it enters a portfolio, start with Card AI bulk scanning. If your goal is to create an eBay listing after scanning, Ludex explicitly documents that flow. If buying, selling or trading within the app matters, CollX and Center Stage document marketplaces. If you already track a wider collection that includes games or comics, PriceCharting documents those categories alongside cards. Card Ladder separates its free price guide from Pro camera search and collection tracking; its official page listed Pro at $20 per month on October 20, 2026.

These are workflow differences, not a ranking of recognition accuracy. We did not run the same physical cards through all six apps.

What does a free sports card scanner app actually include?

Card AI is free to install from its current App Store listing. Its free access currently allows 10 successful scans per account; Premium has different access. A queue of up to 10 photos controls one batch and is not a promise of 10 free scans every day or month. Each candidate still needs review before it is saved.

Sports-card coverage depends on the cataloged category and the specific card. Available prices and history also vary by record. The Google Play store link on this website is still pending, so check the current store listing before choosing a device. No app in this table was ranked by a controlled free-tier speed or recognition test.

Check the card before trusting any price

A rookie card, First Edition printing, Holofoil finish or numbered parallel can have a different market from the base card. Confirm the set, card number, finish, language and raw condition or existing slab grade first. A current price, a past sale and a listing are different evidence. Card AI does not authenticate a card or predict a grade from a photo.

Card scanner app comparison 2026 questions.

Which app should I use to scan a box of cards?

Choose a workflow you can repeat and review. Card AI queues up to 10 camera or gallery images at a time, then asks you to confirm each suggested match. We have not measured its scanning speed against the other apps on this page.

Are the six apps ranked by accuracy?

No. This page compares documented features and workflows. It does not present a controlled recognition or valuation accuracy benchmark.

Does Card AI show eBay sold prices inside the app?

For supported sports cards, Card AI can provide a search link to eBay. The app does not import eBay sold transactions as an in-app price feed.
